ladder.name: Free — prove it works
ladder.gets: Free previews on the paid routes, the public scoreboard, this map, endpoint.json with the live origin.
ladder.why: No card, no key. If the free half is useless, the paid half will be too.

ladder.name: Probe — a fraction of a cent
ladder.gets: Single-fact calls: balances, one market snapshot, one TA read.
ladder.why: Cheapest possible way to check a paywall actually settles.

ladder.name: Signal — cents per decision
ladder.gets: Judgements, not raw data: verdicts, confluence, picks, full trade tickets.
ladder.why: This is the product. The data is free everywhere; the call is not.

ladder.name: Pass — every route, 30 days
ladder.gets: All paid routes for 30 days, one payment, no per-call friction.
ladder.why: Polling agents and desks: one $5 beats forty $0.25 calls.

ladder.name: Audit — a human answer
ladder.gets: Your own endpoint graded, or a market/catalog report on your target.
ladder.why: Where willingness to pay is real: somebody needs a decision about their own thing.

agents.integrate: Send X-PAYMENT or params._meta['x402/payment']; a missing payment returns a standard 402 challenge with accepts[].
